newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - AT&T cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - AT&T cut to hold.

text.p: -- SBC Warburg said it downgraded AT&T Corp to hold from buy following the company's announcement it had selected John Walter as its new president and eventual chief executive.

-- In a research note, analyst Barry Sine said AT&T's valuation remains compelling but added SBC Warburg had expected the announcement of AT&T's new hire "would be so dramatic as to spark a rally in the shares."

"In our view, what was needed was a fresh face with a well-known high tech resume ...," the note continued, "Instead we think Walter will need to spend the first few months familiarizing investors with his background..."
